testimonials.author: Cynthia Del Rio
testimonials.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Kevin Cardenas at Status Roofing on a transaction where I represented the seller. Kevin was extremely professional throughout the entire process and did an outstanding job managing the roof replacement from start to finish.  He was always available to answer questions, communicate updates, and work collaboratively with all parties involved. His responsiveness, knowledge, and commitment to excellent customer service played a significant role in making this a successful and stress free closing. I highly recommend Status Roofing and Kevin Cardenas for anyone looking for a reliable roofing professional.

Cynthia Del Rio, REALTOR®

testimonials.author: Ana Idelsy
testimonials.text:
I highly recommend Status Roofing for anyone needing an honest and professional roof inspection in McKinney, Texas.

During the sale of our home, an inspection report raised concerns about possible hail damage and put our transaction at risk. Sergio and Gage responded immediately, and Gage was able to inspect our roof the same day.

His inspection was thorough, detailed, and incredibly honest. Rather than pushing for a roof replacement, he provided a professional assessment of the roof’s condition, identified the difference between minor foot-traffic wear and actual storm damage, and explained the realities of potential insurance coverage.

Most importantly, Gage confirmed that our roof remains in great condition with plenty of life remaining and no signs of failure. His detailed report helped address the buyer’s concerns and gave us confidence moving forward with the sale.

If you’re looking for a trusted roofing company for roof inspections, hail damage evaluations, roof repair recommendations, or roofing expertise in McKinney and North Texas, Status Roofing delivers exceptional customer service, integrity, and expert advice. Thank you, Sergio and Gage, for protecting our home and helping us through a stressful situation.

testimonials.author: Kathy D
testimonials.text:
We recently had our roof and gutters replaced by Status Roofing and the experience exceeded all expectations - even my husband, a former roofer, was impressed. From the very first consultation to the final walkthrough, Jonathan demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and genuine care.

Jonathan explained every step of the process clearly, was knowledgeable about the materials, and the quote was transparent with no surprises. The crew worked efficiently and the quality of their workmanship was outstanding.

Jonathan and his crew went above and beyond and we are extremely happy with the results. We would confidently recommend Status Roofing to anyone needing a roof or gutter repair/replacement and fence staining.
